title: Starter Sleeper Unit 09 reference and palette study
summary: Founder shifted introductory character study from complex Relay to starter Sleeper Frame Unit 09. The supplied source has strong bone-white angular helmet and chest plates, narrow violet visor, 09-marked shoulder, dark understructure, red cabling, distinctive knees and boots. A 125x321 front standing figure was isolated transparently from the supplied pixel-style sheet and placed in a 160x352 transparent frame. Global 64-color reduction loses purple emissive accents; reserving an 8-color violet ramp then tuning its brightness/saturation preserves the identity. Original source remains benchmark. This was an EXTRACTED REFERENCE AND COLOR STUDY, not new hand-drawn pixel art or production approval. Next must paint the helmet and shoulders from a blank canvas with deliberate clusters and compare at 1x before a full sprite or animation.
